English: Clerks Chamber
A rough wooden shack, with several clerks laboring over ledgers and scrolls by candlelight.
Scribes Office
A makeshift tent or hut where a lone scribe records transactions, population, and taxes on scraps of parchment.
Town Hall
A sturdy timber hall, serving as the administrative heart of the settlement and a gathering place for townsfolk.
Council Hall
A grand hall of stone, where the city council convenes to debate laws and manage urban affairs.
Records Archive
A fireproof stone vault, safely storing land deeds, contracts, and city records for generations.
Chancery
A well-appointed stone building where official documents are drafted, sealed, and dispatched, and city administration is centralized.
Bailiffs Quarters
Residences and offices for bailiffs tasked with enforcing the citys laws and collecting dues.
Magistrates Court
An imposing stone courthouse where city magistrates adjudicate disputes and official matters.
Civic Administration
A sprawling complex where the citys bureaucracy handles taxation, trade, and urban planning with unprecedented efficiency.
Bureau of Governance
The pinnacle of city administration: a fortified and opulent center for all civic functions, symbolizing urban power and prosperity.
